_help: Links for the owner's shop-price Google Form and its Sheet. Question IDs are found automatically (scripts/fetch-form-entries.js -> data/manual-form.json). Guide: docs/manual-entry-guide-th.md. save_url: the address (.../exec) of the owner's own save script, apps-script/save-prices.gs - once it is set, prices are saved through it with the owner's key and the Form is not used (docs/owner-save-key-th.md). Never a key in this file.
